titlePlain: A Failover Test Reveals a Database
titleEmphasis: That Never Made It Into the AG
subtitle: Video 15 of 20 · Brennan Manufacturing

steps.label: BrennanERP fails over cleanly
steps.sub: SYNCHRONIZED / HEALTHY on SQLDBA02, confirmed directly

steps.label: ProductionSchedulingDB breaks
steps.sub: the scheduling module can't find its database at all

steps.label: Check sys.availability_databases_cluster
steps.sub: the authoritative answer: was it ever actually a member of BrennanAG?

code:
-- On SQLDBA01, now the secondary
SELECT name, state_desc, create_date
FROM sys.databases
WHERE name = 'ProductionSchedulingDB';

-- name: ProductionSchedulingDB
-- state_desc: ONLINE
-- a real AG member would have changed role with the failover
caption: Checked directly, not through the application reporting the error.

code:
SELECT adc.database_name, ag.name AS availability_group_name
FROM sys.availability_databases_cluster adc
JOIN sys.availability_groups ag ON adc.group_id = ag.group_id
WHERE ag.name = 'BrennanAG';

-- returns BrennanERP only --
-- ProductionSchedulingDB was never a member at all
caption: Not a failover bug -- a database that was never inside the group that failed over.
